name: sendvideo
description: Central de agendamento e publicação de vídeos (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @sendvideo/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @sendvideo/api" "npm run dev -w @sendvideo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sendvideo/api && npm run build -w @sendvideo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sendvideo/api && npm run typecheck -w @sendvideo/web
